purpose: age-gender-audio 0.1.0 release freeze v2 (freeze card). Supersedes v1 (card [internal id], code 9927071), which had no model code. Pins the exact code, head, ONNX artifacts and R4 release-gate list BEFORE any R4 number is read (METHODOLOGY 4).
previous_version: 0.1.0 freeze v1 (superseded, code 9927071, no model code)

code.source_branch: a feature branch (fast-forwarded into main, local only; no remote)
code.freeze_commit_note: the freeze commit F that adds this file lands on top of f9d1cd1 and changes frozen_config.json only (metadata). Its own hash is recorded on card [internal id] and on gates [internal id], not inside this file.
code.clean_tree: git status --short -> 0 lines before this file was written
code.tests_at_freeze: python -m pytest -q (venv a local venv) -> 18 passed in 7.12s, CPU

head.name: R2 seed 0 heads
head.seed_fixed: seed 0 fixed by the build card before any R4 number; not chosen on R4

int8.recipe: uint8 per-channel dynamic quantization of 60 transformer-layer matmuls; conv front end, fc2 and heads stay fp32

r4_gate_set.audio_dir: <data>/r4_audio (NNNN.mp3, row order; all 1200 per-clip sha256 match the list's audio_sha256, verified at freeze)

flags.held_out_set: R4 release gate: n=1200 Common Voice 17 English clips, one per client_id, speaker-disjoint from R2 train and screen; list hashed and frozen before the first number.
scoring_rules_pinned: Gender accuracy = argmax over the {female, male} logits only; the child logit is ignored for BOTH arms.
Margins are RELATIVE to the incumbent audeering/wav2vec2-large-robust-24-ft-age-gender re-scored on the same frozen clips, first 10 s input as in R2.
Ours = int8 ONNX (shipped artifact); fp32 reported beside it.
Paired bootstrap over clips (clip == speaker), B=2000, seed 20261124. Decision uses the CI BOUND.
flags.r4_release_gate: PASS only if ALL: lower 95% bound of (ours - incumbent) gender accuracy >= -2.0 pp; upper 95% bound of (ours - incumbent) age MAE <= +1.0 yr; int8-vs-fp32 parity |d acc| <= 0.5 pp and |d MAE| <= 0.3 yr on the R4 clips. Else close the line -- no rescue variant, no re-tune-and-rerun.
flags.gate_recipe: score_onnx.py (ours), make_audio_npz.py + lab R2 rescore.py (incumbent, Intel XPU), gate_r4.py -- see r4/README.md
flags.claim_wording: 'level with' only (non-inferiority); report CI bounds; age at decade-bucket resolution; child logit 'not predicted'.

after_freeze: No code, head, ONNX, list, scoring or gate change is allowed after this freeze. Any change means a NEW freeze card and a new held-out draw.
out_of_scope: Any code change after this freeze.
